title: Structure-guided screening of protein-protein interaction for the identification of Myc-Max heterodimer complex modulators.
authors: Bhowmick, Shovonlal; Roy, Kunal; Saha, Achintya
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接和MD模拟筛选Myc-Max异源二聚体PPI调节剂，虽聚焦TF-DNA相关转录因子复合物，但核心是蛋白-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA结合，方法可迁移但对象偏离。
abstract: De-regulation of oncogenic myelocytomatosis (c-Myc or Myc) transcription factor is one of the most common molecular anomalies encountered in human cancers, and it is typically linked to many aggressive malignancies including breast, lung, cervix, colon glioblastomas, and other haematological organs. The Myc belongs to the basic helix-loop-helix zipper protein family (bHLH-ZIP), and its dimerization with another principal interactor protein partner Myc-associated factor X (Max) is essentially required for cellular transformation, cell growth and proliferation, and transcriptional activation. Intermolecular interactions have been evaluated between hetero-dimer Myc-Max protein, which identified protein-protein interaction (PPI) specific modulators using highly precised molecular docking study followed by long-range interaction stability analyzed through molecular dynamic (MD) simulation. Moreover, ADME profile analyses have been estimated for screened hit compounds. MM-GBSA-based binding free energy (DeltaG) estimations have been performed for all screened hit compounds obtained from multi-step molecular docking-based virtual screening technique. According to the employed various rigorous multi-chemometric techniques, four identified inhibitors/modulators appear to have a considerable number of intermolecular contacts with hotspot residues in the hetero-dimer interface region of the Myc-Max PPI complex. However, identified hit compounds might need further structural optimization or extensive biophysical analyses for better understanding of the molecular mechanism for exhibiting the Myc-Max PPI interface binding stability.
abstract_zh: 致癌性骨髓细胞瘤病（c-Myc或Myc）转录因子的失调是人类癌症中最常见的分子异常之一，通常与多种侵袭性恶性肿瘤相关，包括乳腺癌、肺癌、宫颈癌、结肠胶质母细胞瘤及其他血液系统器官。Myc属于碱性螺旋-环-螺旋拉链蛋白家族（bHLH-ZIP），其与另一个主要相互作用蛋白伴侣Myc相关因子X（Max）的二聚化对于细胞转化、细胞生长与增殖以及转录激活至关重要。通过高度精确的分子对接研究评估了异二聚体Myc-Max蛋白之间的分子间相互作用，并利用分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟分析了长程相互作用稳定性。此外，对筛选出的命中化合物进行了ADME谱分析。基于MM-GBSA的结合自由能（DeltaG）估算已对所有通过多步分子对接虚拟筛选技术获得的筛选命中化合物进行。根据所采用的多种严格多化学计量学技术，四个已识别的抑制剂/调节剂在Myc-Max PPI复合物的异二聚体界面区域与热点残基显示出相当数量的分子间接触。然而，所识别的命中化合物可能需要进一步的结构优化或广泛的生物物理分析，以更好地理解其展现Myc-Max PPI界面结合稳定性的分子机制。
